protocol.purpose: Separately declared narrower E3 task family after the write_file arm failed. The model selects a bounded set_constant tool; the host never chooses the repair.
protocol.workspace_history: disabled (workspace rebuilt each decision; previous-workspace recurrence is not used)

fixtures.roles_note: Fresh source groups; none were used in prior E3 training or evaluation. Held-out groups are assessed once.

alignment.example_order: deterministic round-robin over (train case, teacher step) sorted by case id and step
alignment.loss: teacher-forced next-token cross entropy on the set_constant action JSON plus EOS; prompt prefix masked
alignment.teacher_policy: read_file -> run_test -> set_constant -> run_test -> stop; host-authored labels only, never evaluation action selection

evaluation.interruption_plan: CLI process 1 observes the failing test, host correction bumps revision, process 2 resumes with workspace_zero
evaluation.success_rule: only the independent evaluator command may satisfy the success condition

success_head.kind: task-success prediction from detached task features plus pooled first-decision workspace

checkpoint.save_policy: one final extension-only export after alignment and optional success-head fitting; no base copy or optimizer checkpoint

claims.implemented: bounded set_constant tool, fresh task family, model-driven loop and restart
claims.trained: modules-only alignment on fresh train trajectories
claims.measured: held-out task completion, action/argument correctness, controls and costs
claims.not_claimed: generalization, calibrated confidence, write_file repair, self-improvement
